parsed.why: No criminalisation of expression, no documented border, facility or police exposure, proud LGBT institutional record and high polled tolerance. LGB-framed only, one undated trans attack, no documented visitor-facing remedy — good but unproven for trans visitors.

Article 521 expressly imprisons trans feminine presentation up to six years; documented police raids, arrests and intrusive anal exams, state ban on LGBT gatherings, rising capital violence. No recognition; judicial pushback only partial.

Presentation offence struck down in 2022 but dress policing persisted; enforced sodomy law used against gender-nonconforming people, 2017 arrest for feminine appearance, official discrimination continuing, no NGO or effective recourse. Tier-2 state tolerance.

Enforced religious cross-dressing offence with documented detention and fine, police monitoring and outing intimidation, stoning regime under revocable moratorium, no document change and no independent human-rights organisations. Severe penalties with nil recourse.

Self-ID recognition, marriage equality, national hate-crime plan, cantonal identity-respecting detention clause and support services; no trans-specific criminalisation or facility ban. Offsets: rising LGBTIQ hate reports, police not recording bias, unsourced national detention placement.
